label: Situation at
definition: Date of the reported situation, for example the date the programme was approved or the date of the decision not to establish one.

label: Programme obligation
definition: Whether the Member State is obliged to provide a national implementation programme.

label: Programme reference
definition: Reference to the national implementation programme in the documents dataset.

label: Prioritisation reference
definition: Reference to the methodology used to prioritise investments.

label: Article 5 management plan reference
definition: Reference to the document listing the Member State's integrated urban wastewater management plans.

label: Risk assessment
definition: Whether a risk assessment of urban wastewater discharges has been carried out in accordance with Article 18.

label: Risk assessment date
definition: Date of issue of the risk assessment.

label: Risks identified
definition: Whether any risks have been identified. Measures under Article 18(2) that address identified risks are reported in {ref}`art23-measure`.

label: Risk summary reference
definition: Reference to the relevant section of the river basin management plan, or to another official summary of the identified risks and adopted measures.

label: Producer responsibility contribution
definition: Estimated financial contribution from producer responsibility organisations, total at national level.
condition: Required unless `producerResponsibilityEstimateBasedOn` = `notAvailable`, and empty if it is

label: Currency
definition: Currency of `producerResponsibilityContribution`, in millions of that currency. Euro area Member States use EUR.

label: Estimate based on
definition: Basis of the estimate, or `notAvailable` where no estimate is available yet.

label: Contribution period
definition: Period or periods by which the planned resources, including the contribution in `producerResponsibilityContribution`, are expected to be sufficient to meet the requirements of the Directive. Select one or more.

label: Other contribution period
definition: Explanation of the period, where `contributionPeriod` includes `other`.

label: Remarks
definition: Other important information on compliance and its assessment.
